title: We have a Winner!  Lowe's Gift Card
description: Thanks to all of you I have reached another milestone of over 800 subscribers!  Congratulations to FallenSkys Prepper!  Please check out his channel at https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCoeLew4quiQ0cDlmPQK2QbaQ     Email address: [EMAIL]

asr.full_text: Hello fellow YouTubers. This is Angela with Angela's Busy Bees Garden and Homestead. And today I have with me my granddaughter Ava. And of course we're celebrating over 800 subscribers. And to show my appreciation, I wanted to do a $30 Lowe's gift card. And so all you had to do in order to enter into the drawing. Was to leave a comment below in the comment section of my video. Announcing 800 subscribers. And I have taken every entry and have placed the channel on a piece of. Paper and placed it inside of this red pot. And my granddaughter Ava is going to do the honors. Of selecting the lucky winner. So Ava, I want you to turn your head away and reach into the red pot. And pull out the lucky winner. Got it just one. Fallen skies prepper fallen skies prepper and here's our winner guys the fallen skies. Skies prepper so please send me your information so that i can get your 30. Lowe's gift card to you. And again, guys, I want to thank you so much for your support. And encouragement since I've been a YouTube content creator and wish you all the very best. In your garden season this 2020. Thank you so much for watching. And if you like this video,. Please hit the like button, subscribe and hit the notification bell for future videos. Thank you so much. God bless.

textual.context: Presented as a subscriber-appreciation giveaway with a stated drawing process; the records do not clarify what information the winner should send or whether the gift card was delivered.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised gift card is linked first to a comment-entry action and then to a request for the selected winner to provide information, a relationship requiring later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish the type or sensitivity of the requested information, any payment or transfer requirement, the identity of the recipient beyond the stated channel, or the outcome of the giveaway.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker describes selecting the winner from written channel entries placed in a pot and identifies Fallen Skies Prepper as the winner.

textual_context_notes.observation: The description identifies the announced winner's channel and provides an email address for contact, without stating that the email address is for the giveaway.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a subscriber-appreciation drawing for a $30 Lowe's gift card, with entry described as leaving a comment rather than paying money or investing. Written entries are placed in a red pot and the winner is shown on a handwritten strip, supporting a giveaway presentation. Although the winner is asked to send information to receive the prize, the available video evidence does not identify a payment or credential demand.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary giveaway: a $30 Lowe's gift card is offered as subscriber appreciation, entry requires leaving a comment, and a drawing selects a winner. The records do not show a payment requirement or a purported gift-card generator.
